title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering?
content: Article URL: https://blog.florianherrengt.com/ai-removing-middle-class-software-engineering.html Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49271994 Points: 874 # Comments: 779
summary: 文章探讨AI对软件工程职业结构的影响，认为AI正在消除中阶工程师岗位，导致行业两极分化：初级和高级工程师需求增加，而中间层被压缩。作者基于个人观察和行业趋势，分析了AI工具如何改变工作流程、团队结构及职业发展路径，并讨论了这对个人和公司的潜在影响。
highlights: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering?
The article discusses how AI tools are reshaping the demand for engineers, potentially eliminating mid-level roles.
It highlights a polarization effect where junior and senior engineers become more valuable while middle-tier positions shrink.
